item.title: ICLVR on the future of the search for Columba McVeigh
item.description: The most recent search for the remains of Columba McVeigh, one of the "disappeared" on Bragan Bog Co Monaghan has ended without success. The Independent Commission for the Location of Victims' Remains (ICLVR) made the announcement, the say the McVeigh family has been informed. Columba McVeigh was abducted, murdered and secretly buried by the IRA in 1975 when he was aged 19. item.title: New development plan for Smithboro to begin in 2026
item.description: The Ballybay/Clones MD has adopted a new development plan for the village of Smithboro. Monaghan County Council confirmed that they will deliver a village development plan in each of the municipal districts over the next number of years. Cllr Sinead Flynn proposed at this week's sitting of the Ballybay/Clones MD to commence with the village of Smithboro in 2026. item.title: Sister of Columba McVeigh 'heartbroken' as Monaghan search ends
item.description: 'Heartbreaking' is how the result of the latest search for one of the so-called Disappeared is being described. The search for the remains of Columba McVeigh on Bragan Bog in County Monaghan has ended without success. His sister Dympna Kerr says she was informed yesterday that the search had ended. She said her reply to the lead investigator Eamonn Henry who called her was have you found him?. item.title: Stolen Co Cavan car used to ram police vehicle
item.description: Two people have been arrested after a police vehicle was rammed by a stolen car in Enniskillen. According to police, the car was stolen from Cootehill in Co Cavan. Police on patrol as part of Operation Season's Greetings spotted a silver Ford Fiesta on the Cornagrade Road in Enniskillen shortly before 1am this morning.
